title: A Quadratic Vertex Threshold for Isolated Cliques in the Minimum Degree Kruskal-Katona Problem for 3-Uniform Hypergraphs
summary: Given a set $X$ and an integer $t$, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of $k$-subsets of $X$. The Kruskal-Katona theorem states that if $|\mathcal{F}|\geq \binom{t}{k}$, then $|\partial_{k-1}\mathcal{F}|\geq\binom{t}{k-1}$. The minimum degree version of this problem asks: if $δ(\mathcal{F})\geq \binom{t}{k-1}$, how small can $|\partial_{k-1}\mathcal{F}|$ be? In this article, for the case $k=3$, we prove that, for every sufficiently large integer \(t\), every extremal hypergraph for this problem contains an isolated copy of $K_{t+1}^3$ whenever $|X| \geq ct^2 + o(t^2)$, with the constant $c = 1 +…
